name: mcp_auto_loader_gi
description: Automatically discover and load reviewed Genomic Intelligence DNA sequence-analysis tools when GENOMIC_INTELLIGENCE_MCP_URL is configured. Provides transformer DNA language-model predictions over six tasks (promoter, splice sites, enhancer activity, chromatin state, expression, gene annotation) plus a composite find-genes-then-predict-expression workflow, and helpers that fetch sequence from Ensembl into a reusable handle. The hosted public server needs no API key; calls run against a shared, rate-limited demo quota. For research and development use, not clinical or diagnostic decisions.

tool_contracts.name: list_models
tool_contracts.title: List Genomic Intelligence models
tool_contracts.description: List reviewed model identifiers for promoter, splice, enhancer, chromatin, expression, or annotation tasks before selecting an explicit model for a prediction.

tool_contracts.name: fetch_ensembl_sequence
tool_contracts.title: Fetch an Ensembl gene sequence
tool_contracts.description: Fetch a gene reference sequence from Ensembl into a server-side handle for reuse by prediction tools. Use fetch_gene_for_expression for expression-specific windows.

tool_contracts.name: fetch_region
tool_contracts.title: Fetch an Ensembl genomic region
tool_contracts.description: Fetch a genomic coordinate range from Ensembl into a server-side sequence handle for gene finding or prediction. Plus strand is the reviewed annotation default.

tool_contracts.name: fetch_gene_for_expression
tool_contracts.title: Prepare a gene expression window
tool_contracts.description: Resolve a gene TSS through Ensembl and create the exact TSS-centred server-side sequence handle required by the reviewed expression model.

tool_contracts.name: load_demo_sequence
tool_contracts.title: Load a bundled demo sequence
tool_contracts.description: Load a curated task-specific positive-control sequence into a server-side handle for keyless end-to-end smoke testing without consuming Ensembl quota.

tool_contracts.name: store_inline_sequence
tool_contracts.title: Store an inline DNA sequence
tool_contracts.description: Send a supplied DNA sequence to the configured third-party MCP service and receive a reusable server-side handle. Do not send private or identifiable genomic data to the shared public demo endpoint.

tool_contracts.name: predict_promoter
tool_contracts.title: Predict promoter regions
tool_contracts.description: Predict promoter regions with a reviewed Genomic Intelligence model. Prefer a server-side sequence_ref; raw sequence input is sent to the configured third-party MCP service.

tool_contracts.name: predict_splice
tool_contracts.title: Predict splice sites
tool_contracts.description: Predict splice donor and acceptor sites with a reviewed Genomic Intelligence model. Prefer sequence_ref; raw sequence input is sent to the configured service.

tool_contracts.name: predict_enhancer
tool_contracts.title: Predict enhancer activity
tool_contracts.description: Predict enhancer activity with a reviewed Genomic Intelligence model. Prefer sequence_ref; raw sequence input is sent to the configured third-party service.

tool_contracts.name: predict_chromatin
tool_contracts.title: Predict chromatin features
tool_contracts.description: Predict chromatin annotations across reviewed features with a Genomic Intelligence model. Prefer sequence_ref; raw sequence input is sent to the configured service.

tool_contracts.name: predict_expression
tool_contracts.title: Predict gene expression
tool_contracts.description: Predict expression from the required TSS-centred window and experimental context. Use fetch_gene_for_expression; raw sequence input is sent to the configured service.

tool_contracts.name: find_genes
tool_contracts.title: Find genes in a DNA sequence
tool_contracts.description: Find transcript intervals and gene structure in a sequence. Public demo users must keep wait=true; detached jobs require a private key. Raw sequence input is sent to the configured service.

tool_contracts.name: find_genes_and_predict_expression
tool_contracts.title: Find genes and predict expression
tool_contracts.description: Find genes and predict per-gene expression in one server-side workflow. Public demo users must keep wait=true; detached jobs require a private key. Experimental context is required.

tool_contracts.name: get_job
tool_contracts.title: Get a Genomic Intelligence job
tool_contracts.description: Poll a detached Genomic Intelligence job. This requires a private GI key because the shared public demo disables pollable detached jobs and caller-specific history.

tool_contracts.name: list_jobs
tool_contracts.title: List recent Genomic Intelligence jobs
tool_contracts.description: List recent asynchronous jobs for the configured Genomic Intelligence identity. This requires a private GI key; the shared public demo intentionally disables caller job history.

GENOMIC_INTELLIGENCE_MCP_URL.purpose: Endpoint URL for the opt-in Genomic Intelligence MCP service.
GENOMIC_INTELLIGENCE_MCP_URL.without: Leave blank to keep this third-party MCP service disabled. To use its public demo, set https://mcp.genomicintelligence.ai/mcp.

GENOMIC_INTELLIGENCE_API_KEY.purpose: Optional private Genomic Intelligence credential sent as X-GI-Key to the configured MCP endpoint.
GENOMIC_INTELLIGENCE_API_KEY.without: The hosted public demo works without a key but uses a shared, rate-limited evaluation quota and is not suitable for private sequences or production.

operation.description: The operation to perform: discover tools, generate configs, or call a tool directly

tool_name.description: Name of the MCP tool to call (required for call_tool operation)

tool_arguments.description: Arguments to pass to the MCP tool (for call_tool operation)

return_schema.description: MCP server auto-discovered tools and their execution results. Structure varies by discovered tool (fetch_*, predict_*, find_genes*, get_job, list_jobs, list_models, store_inline_sequence).
